description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that provides static methods for logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It acts as a wrapper and interface for Android's native logging system, and manages a chain of LogNode objects to which log messages can be delegated or chained together.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static logging methods and log level constants, acting as an intermediary between application code and the Android native Log system. It manages a chain of LogNode objects for flexible log handling.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to which log messages are sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, with optional Throwable.
